claim_audits.passage_entailment: The 43%, 8% and 36% entries and bounded semiconductor supply/process history match the cited tables and discussion.
claim_audits.population_and_measure: Worldwide crystalline-silicon module cost reconstructions, matching 1980–2001 and distinct 2001–2012 intervals; shares of modeled cost change, not adopter shares or installed electricity cost.
claim_audits.rival_and_diagnosticity: Different model structures and reconstructed inputs jointly explain why allocations can differ; no controlled decomposition isolates equation change alone. The claim is descriptive rather than a policy-effect estimate.
claim_audits.remaining_limit: Neither model was re-estimated; original industry inputs and upstream semiconductor records remain inherited. Advisory: say model-and-input sensitivity.

claim_audits.passage_entailment: Archived original passages explicitly contain the baseline shares, inclusion of pilot/nonroutine work in R&D and the reported alternative-assignment exercise.
claim_audits.population_and_measure: Representative high-energy 18650 cells for 1995–2000 versus 2010–2015; modeled cost per Wh. Neither packs nor all battery services nor workers' contribution shares.
claim_audits.rival_and_diagnosticity: Intertwined process research and routine manufacturing remain a credible classification rival. The observed sensitivity test changes selected material-price/hardware assignments, not every plausible process classification. Underdetermined is appropriate.
claim_audits.remaining_limit: No full PDF acquired in this review and no supplement/model replication. Public/private R&D policy effects cannot be inferred.

claim_audits.passage_entailment: The reported market and product changes match; the dependent price/cost series is worldwide rather than exclusively US.
claim_audits.population_and_measure: US evidence about market structure is interpreted alongside worldwide module prices. The frozen wording needs to keep those populations distinct.
claim_audits.rival_and_diagnosticity: Manufacturing learning, changing quality, margins and standardization can operate together. Residual engineering-model error alone cannot allocate their contributions. The frozen underdetermined status is retained.
claim_audits.remaining_limit: The wider real rival is a joint account, not simply zero market change. No matched unchanged-product counterfactual was reconstructed.

claim_audits.passage_entailment: The nomination supports opposition, rapid water recession and flood-limited trap function; the community project text gives 1954 completion.
claim_audits.population_and_measure: Tae Rak lake-margin structures and their operating water conditions, not all fishing by all Gunditjmara and not a measured catch or employment effect.
claim_audits.rival_and_diagnosticity: Independent livelihood or preference change cannot alone explain observed loss of hydraulic opportunity and documented objections. It can still affect labor/catches. The bounded disabling claim is supported without identifying all outcomes.
claim_audits.remaining_limit: Shared project/heritage lineage, no original opposition letters, independent flow records or catch time series. Grazing beneficiaries are not evaluated.

claim_audits.passage_entailment: Fire-size, clustering and reported rainfall relations match. The ground check is burn-age classification, and no environmental-selection exclusion is established.
claim_audits.population_and_measure: 1999–2010 spinifex region; proxied Aboriginal and lightning regimes cover approximately 10% and 50% of the area, leaving mixed/unclassified areas outside that comparison. Fire centroids determine assigned regime.
claim_audits.rival_and_diagnosticity: Track/community siting and environmental heterogeneity can affect both exposure classification and fire behavior. Broad vegetation similarity and a shared rainfall record do not eliminate that rival. Separate significant/nonsignificant coefficients do not test a between-slope difference.
claim_audits.remaining_limit: No imagery reclassification, spatial-control reanalysis or independent ignition census; no direct mammal population or welfare outcomes.

claim_audits.passage_entailment: The published ethnographic description includes restricted burning rights, possible retribution and social rewards for caring for Country.
claim_audits.population_and_measure: Contemporary observed Martu context; an account of norms and meanings rather than a census of adherence or sanctions.
claim_audits.rival_and_diagnosticity: Descriptive correction to an institution-free reading. It does not assign a causal weight between immediate hunting returns, obligations and reputation; those motives may coexist.
claim_audits.remaining_limit: No quantified independent enforcement dataset or individual longitudinal motivation study. Same paper as K11 is not independent corroboration.

claim_audits.passage_entailment: The complete publisher abstract advances the stated dividend, investment, tariff and limited-use account.
claim_audits.population_and_measure: Late-Qing Telegraph Administration as interpreted by Yoon; abstract supplies neither a customer denominator nor tariff elasticity or investment series.
claim_audits.rival_and_diagnosticity: Capital scarcity, technical difficulty and low demand could also produce high tariffs and restrained investment. Frozen low-confidence hypothesis and underdetermined test correctly preserve this.
claim_audits.remaining_limit: No body text or underlying administrative records audited. Price effects among traders do not refute restricted mass direct usage.

claim_audits.passage_entailment: Table 3 high-quality-rice coefficients divided by Table 1 mean reproduce the reported range; data and methods establish the stated outcome and frame.
claim_audits.population_and_measure: 47,436 observed prefecture-months in 130 prefectures/nine provinces over a 420-month frame, 1870–1904; monthly reported wholesale maxima, not consumer means or national welfare.
claim_audits.rival_and_diagnosticity: Pretrends, fixed effects/trends, transport/port controls, selected-location exclusions and network predictions test concrete alternatives. Unmeasured concurrent changes, reporting response, timing and staggered-treatment assumptions remain. The label is conditional source-design evidence, not randomized or replicated proof.
claim_audits.remaining_limit: No original regressions, microdata or staggered-DID re-estimation. Shared institutional narrative with Yoon does not turn two papers into independent tests of dividend causality.

claim_audits.passage_entailment: Both inspected editions report 11.0%, 1.8% and 4.5% for the stated intervals, and explain sparse observations and interpolation. Publisher confirms a separate interval typo correction absent from the frozen claim.
claim_audits.population_and_measure: A reconstructed seven-product respectability index from inherited market-price observations; rates are not a continuous national price census or household-specific cost-of-living series.
claim_audits.rival_and_diagnosticity: Uneven preservation, basket weights and interpolated prices can affect rate magnitudes. This is a descriptive attributed reconstruction, not an identified causal account of currency change.
claim_audits.remaining_limit: No underlying Li data or CPI replication. The source's corrected doubling interval is documented rather than silently importing another edition.

advisories.text: Model sensitivity also includes changed historical input reconstructions. Nemet's 1980 plant size is 125 kW/year; Kavlak's is 1 MW/year. Do not infer that changing the equation alone caused the allocation difference.
Keep the sensitivity exercise bounded to the active-material price and hardware assignments actually tested; it is not unrestricted reassignment of all process work.
Add the known publisher correction to the source ledger if useful; preserve accepted-versus-published edition distinction. The selected claim's numbers are unchanged in both editions.
For precise future reproduction, record 47,436 observed prefecture-months within the 130×420 frame. Current phrasing does not claim a complete panel.

rejected_candidate_findings.candidate: Accepted manuscript's doubling interval conflicts with Figure 6, so the frozen inflation claim may be wrong.
rejected_candidate_findings.resolution: Publisher explicitly corrected the separate interval from 1260–1355 to 1346–1355 on 7 March 2024. The frozen claim excludes that sentence; its three attributed rates appear unchanged in the corrected published version. Do not report a transcription error or fabricate corrected rates from a plotted line.

limits: Original technical inputs, archival letters, raw imagery/field observations and econometric microdata were not independently reconstructed.
Full-text file availability is distinct from complete text audit; only listed passages were inspected.
ENE-S11 conclusions depend on original archived partial source extracts after fresh download failures; POL-S08 remains abstract-only.
Multiple records or papers sharing the same evidence are not independent corroboration.
No prevalence, national representativeness, livelihood-transition or welfare inference follows from the selected cases.
Future synthesis/export changes require version comparison and verification; this review addresses only the frozen manifest.
